# Set46 candidate card core contract — review draft

Draft against `slug-event-card` after Set45 and the recorded C1 exception. No runtime or expected-output generation is authorized by this draft. The companion helper contract owns parent installation, wire envelopes and UI. Existing D13/D28/D52 are unchanged; general widening, record filters and next-week priority remain open.

## 1. Exact candidate behavior

Only the two existing published fixture gyms, with at most one saved entrant per class per gym, participate. Preserve every Set44 `ParticipantSnapshot.Members` row, including cutoff-ineligible entrants: max10 total, max5 bouts. All matching uses retained noon condition v1 and unchanged D65 `RatingHundredths`; no current-time reprojection, form, training, fight simulation, awards, XP, ownership transfer or professional record mutation.

The profile's professional-record basis is exactly `candidate_zero_record_no_results_authority`: both fixtures have no professional-results authority in this namespace. Each displayed record is wins0/losses0/draws0 by this explicit candidate assumption. XP0 is separately required by the unchanged source validator; it is not proof of a zero professional record. This profile must not be relabelled a production record authority or extended to imported nonzero records.

Class order is exactly `light`, `welter`, `middle`, `light_heavy`, `heavy`. For a class containing one eligible entrant from each gym, pair iff `2 * min(rating_a,rating_b) >= max(rating_a,rating_b)`, inclusive. Ratings are positive for eligible entrants and bounded 0..100000 for every encoded entrant; multiply after widening to uint64. This is the unchanged half-to-double band; only widen-to-five is waived. There is at most one opponent, so no shuffle, greedy choice or meaningful random opponent selection exists.

Every entrant gets exactly one outcome, in this priority: own source eligibility `retired` → `retired_at_cutoff`; own `not_rostered` → `not_rostered_at_cutoff`; no opposing same-class saved member → `no_opponent_in_class`; opposing member exists but is ineligible → `opponent_ineligible_at_cutoff`; both eligible but outside band → `outside_rating_band`; otherwise `paired` with empty reason. Paired opponents reference the same bout. Entrant order is class index, then full GymID, then full ProspectID. Bout order is class index; corners are full ProspectID ascending. Object-key/JSON-whitespace reordering in valid transport cannot alter canonical output. Every array order is semantic and must already match its declared canonical ordering; parsers do not silently sort malformed arrays. All full ProspectIDs must be globally unique across both participants; any duplicate refuses the source/card before pairing, even across different gyms/classes, because bout corners reference full ProspectID alone.

Global and per-gym counts are exact: `total_count = paired_count + unmatched_count`, `paired_count = 2*bout_count` globally, and every unmatched reason count sums to unmatched_count. `eligible_count` counts source eligibility exactly `eligible`, independent of whether matched. Both gym count rows exist in pinned GymID order, including empty gyms. Empty complete snapshots produce a legitimate empty card; incomplete source is never treated as empty.

## 2. Source seam in gymseed (additive; no old DTO changes)

Canonical field order and exact Go types:

- `CardSource`: `version uint32=1; store_id string; event_key string; source_receipt gymevent.SnapshotReceipt; declaration SignedDeclaration; anchor Anchor; target Target; finality Finality`. These are value fields, never nullable. Pin supplied separately. They are an owned projection of a retained valid seed Record after historical finality, excluding mutable publication/cursors/restarts/conflicts/incident/observations. No chain revalidation or absence-proof claim is added.
- `CardState`: `version uint32=1; status Status; source_digest string`. SourceDigest is empty until a complete CardSource exists, including when absent/unfinalized; after first historical finality it is the immutable CardSourceDigest even if relevant conflict later appears. Status retains exact existing seed meanings, including local observation versus last chain observation.
- `CardView`: `version uint32=1; store_id string; pin Pin; created_at_ms int64; participant_account_id string; participant_gym_id string; observed_at_ms int64; states []CardState`. States match requested Saturdays in ascending date order, max8; empty list is allowed for source authorization only. All contained status.observed_at_ms equal view.observed_at_ms; status.store_id matches view.store_id/ID(Pin), and events/keys match that Pin in requested ascending date order. CreatedAtMS is immutable source-journal initialization time, positive<=ObservedAtMS. Participant account/gym is exactly one pinned fixture pair. CardState.source_digest is nonempty iff status.finalized_at_ms>0, including after conflict; its actual digest equality is checked only when the source projection is available.

Exact proposed APIs:

```go
func (s *Store) WithCardView(ctx context.Context, events *gymevent.Store, entries *gymentry.Store, session gymstable.Session, saturdays []string, commit func(CardView, func() error) error) error
func (s *Store) WithCardSource(ctx context.Context, events *gymevent.Store, entries *gymentry.Store, session gymstable.Session, saturday string, prepare func(CardSource) (func(CardView, func() error) error, error)) error
func CardSourceDigest(expected Pin, value CardSource) (string, error)
```

For each new X expose `ValidateX(expected Pin,value X)(X,error)`, `MarshalX(expected Pin,value X)([]byte,error)`, `ParseX(expected Pin,raw []byte)(X,error)`. Validate returns an owned copy. CardSource validation checks all cross-bindings from the unchanged seed validator: compiled Pin, exact source receipt/declaration and signatures, payload, anchor/target heights and parent header linkage, retained exact-target checkpoint, historical finality and times. Available chronology is explicit: source receipt cutoff/capture/completion relations pass the unchanged event validator; `source_receipt.completed_at_ms <= target.observed_at_ms <= finality.observed_at_ms`; target observed tip includes target; finality checkpoint height/hash equals target, and finality.tip.height-target.height equals retained descendants>=60. Validate the exact expected declaration/receipt and carrier payload, anchor/target structural validators and target parent=anchor.hash. Omitted PreparedAtMS, publication, cursor and incident fields are not fabricated or claimed checked by this projection validator. This is pure bounded semantic validation, no signing/RPC/Argon/SVG. It does not manufacture portable proof of first-anchor absence. Reuse existing internal validators, not a success-Boolean import or a synthetic mutable Record.

`WithCardView` takes the seed gate; validates all requested dates (unique ascending, 0..8) and authorizes original View before reading source records; decodes/validates/hashes projections outside the final account lease. Under the final source View it advances source clock and any existing seed incident observations, constructs the bounded final CardView, calls the supplied recheck, then the consumer's short callback. No source write follows that callback in that invocation. It neither allocates missing seed rows nor reconciles the chain. A failed own seed sync poisons and returns outcome_unknown; a committed seed observation followed by failure is also outcome_unknown. This means uncertainty about metadata observation, never an implicit card build or transaction dispatch.

`WithCardSource` uses the same gate/authorization. Require an existing valid complete seed Record, retained Target and historical Finality, and no Conflicts/ConflictOverflow. Missing/unfinalized maps to the existing `gymseed.ErrSourceIncomplete` (`seed_source_incomplete`); conflict maps to existing `gymseed.ErrConflict` (`seed_conflict`). The gymcard layer maps these to `card_source_incomplete` and `card_source_conflict`; no old seed error string is widened or renamed. Copy CardSource, validate/canonicalize, then invoke prepare outside account/store mutexes while retaining the seed resource gate. Final source View samples/persists clocks and incident facts before commit, checks the original session and exact immutable source digest, and supplies one matching CardState. It never replaces historical Finality with current depth: offline or a shallow above-target reorg alone does not prevent a new candidate card; relevant retained anchor/target/auth conflict does. The callback has no node/publisher handle. Nil handles/callbacks/context and malformed dates fail before effects.

## 3. gymcard canonical DTOs

All fields appear in listed order, snake_case JSON tags exactly as shown; arrays nonnull. No maps or generic JSON values. Integers are unsigned canonical decimal in JSON except named int64 timestamps, which are nonnegative canonical decimal; all counters <=2^53-1, times positive <=8640000000000000 except explicit absent zero. IDs/digests are lowercase64-hex, optional IDs empty. All strings are ASCII. Nested old types retain their frozen tags/semantics. No full manifest or SVG is present.

- `Pin`: `version uint32=1; source_store_id string; source_pin gymseed.Pin; rules_id string`.
- `Info`: `version uint32=1; store_id string; pin Pin; source_created_at_ms int64; created_at_ms int64; event_count uint32`.
- `ProfessionalRecord`: `wins uint32=0; losses uint32=0; draws uint32=0`.
- `ReasonCounts`: `retired_at_cutoff uint32; not_rostered_at_cutoff uint32; no_opponent_in_class uint32; opponent_ineligible_at_cutoff uint32; outside_rating_band uint32`.
- `Counts`: `total_count uint32; eligible_count uint32; paired_count uint32; unmatched_count uint32; reasons ReasonCounts`.
- `GymCounts`: `gym_id string; counts Counts`. Per-gym counts use fighter counts only; bouts are counted once globally.
- `Entrant`: `prospect_id string; gym_id string; account_id string; display_name string; class string; rating_hundredths uint32; cutoff_eligibility string; professional_record ProfessionalRecord; state string; reason string; bout_id string`. State `paired|unmatched`. Paired has empty reason/nonempty bout_id; unmatched has one exact reason/empty bout_id. Every field is derived from the source and compiled record basis, never caller input. DisplayName is exactly `fightermanifest.GenerateText(1, Assignment.WorkHash).Name.Display` under the source's already pinned descriptor, ASCII1..128 bytes; validate the generated manifest digest against the source Assignment.ManifestDigest. This is the existing deterministic name, not a new name authority; no portrait render is needed. Derive/validate once outside account leases, never from the UI poll path.
- `Bout`: `bout_id string; class string; corner_a string; corner_b string; seed string`. The seed is a committed candidate future-use identifier only; no fight runs.
- `Plan`: `version uint32=1; card_id string; input_id string; seed string; record_basis string; counts Counts; bout_count uint32; gyms []GymCounts; entrants []Entrant; bouts []Bout`.
- `Record`: `version uint32=1; store_id string; card_id string; source gymseed.CardSource; source_digest string; plan Plan; created_at_ms int64`.
- `Status`: `version uint32=1; store_id string; card_id string; event gymevent.Event; exists bool; record_digest string; created_at_ms int64; observed_at_ms int64; counts Counts; bout_count uint32; source gymseed.CardState; usable bool`.
- `BuildResult`: `version uint32=1; record Record; status Status; replayed bool`.
- `ReadResult`: `version uint32=1; record Record; status Status`.
- `HistoryPage`: `version uint32=1; store_id string; after_card_id string; next_card_id string; has_more bool; observed_at_ms int64; cards []Status`.

Source is a separate immutable record field; mutable conflict/deadline/current-depth state appears only in Status.Source. `usable` is true iff a card exists, its source digest equals current retained CardSourceDigest, historical finality exists, and source conflicts/overflow are absent. It does not claim current network freshness or official booking. Every returned existing Status has CreatedAtMS<=ObservedAtMS, and nested source status.ObservedAtMS<=ObservedAtMS. All History cards share the page's ObservedAtMS; each BuildResult/ReadResult status names its exact Record/CardID/RecordDigest/counts/bout_count. An absent Status has record_digest empty, creation0, zero Counts, bout_count0, usable=false; the deterministic CardID/Event and authentic source state remain present.

## 4. Identity and seed recipes

`H` is SHA256; `ID` decodes lowercase64-hex to raw32 bytes; `LE32` unsigned32 little endian; `LP` is LE32 byte length plus bytes; `J` is canonical UTF-8 JSON with fields above/no whitespace/LF. NUL in domains is actual byte00. Hashes use natural digest byte order, including target hash decoded from its displayed hex; no implicit reversal.

Rules are exactly the ordered object:
`{"version":1,"scope":"two_fixture_candidate","record_basis":"candidate_zero_record_no_results_authority","classes":["light","welter","middle","light_heavy","heavy"],"band_min_numerator":1,"band_min_denominator":2,"band_max_numerator":2,"band_max_denominator":1,"widen_to_five":false,"condition_version":1,"rating":"D65","cutoff_eligibility":true,"max_entrants":10,"max_bouts":5}`.

- `RulesID = H("SLUG candidate card rules\0v1\0" || LP(J(Rules)))`.
- `StoreID = H("SLUG candidate card store\0v1\0" || LP(J(Pin)))`; CandidatePin requires source.ID/source full Pin and this compiled RulesID.
- `CardID = H("SLUG candidate card event\0v1\0" || ID(StoreID) || ID(gymevent.Event.EventID))`. This stable event conflict identity is available before Build. It cannot be changed by a new nonce/target/observation.
- `CardSourceDigest = H("SLUG candidate card source\0v1\0" || LP(J(CardSource)))`. Immutable receipt/capture and first-Finality evidence bytes affect this evidence digest, not card/bout random recipes.
- `InputID = H("SLUG candidate card input\0v1\0" || ID(CardID) || ID(snapshot_digest) || ID(seed.EventKey) || LE32(target.height) || ID(target.hash) || ID(RulesID))`.
- `Plan.seed = H("SLUG candidate card seed\0v1\0" || ID(InputID) || ID(target.hash))`.
- `BoutID = H("SLUG candidate card bout\0v1\0" || ID(InputID) || LE32(class_index) || ID(corner_a) || ID(corner_b))`, class_index0..4.
- `Bout.seed = H("SLUG candidate card bout seed\0v1\0" || ID(Plan.seed) || ID(BoutID))`.
- `RecordDigest = H("SLUG candidate card record\0v1\0" || LP(J(Record)))`.

No PRNG draws are needed: each class has at most one possible pair. These seeds commit the candidate source and do not select an opponent, reroll form or activate an engine recipe. Signatures, capture/creation/finality-observation times, current chain tip, current session/generation and mutable seed RecordDigest never enter InputID or bout seed. Re-signing an equivalent checkpoint cannot reroll a card.

## 5. Core API and bounds

```go
func CandidatePin(source gymseed.Pin) (Pin,error)
func ID(Pin) (string,error)
func RulesID() string
func CardID(Pin, gymevent.Event) (string,error)
func RecordDigest(Pin, Record) (string,error)
func Create(ctx context.Context,path string,pin Pin,seeds *gymseed.Store) (*Store,error)
func Open(ctx context.Context,path string,expected Pin,seeds *gymseed.Store) (*Store,error)
func ResumePrepared(ctx context.Context,path string,expected Pin,seeds *gymseed.Store) (*Store,error)
func (s *Store) Close() error
func (s *Store) Info(ctx context.Context) (Info,error)
func (s *Store) Build(ctx context.Context,seeds *gymseed.Store,events *gymevent.Store,entries *gymentry.Store,session gymstable.Session,saturday string) (BuildResult,error)
func (s *Store) Read(ctx context.Context,seeds *gymseed.Store,events *gymevent.Store,entries *gymentry.Store,session gymstable.Session,saturday string) (ReadResult,error)
func (s *Store) Status(ctx context.Context,seeds *gymseed.Store,events *gymevent.Store,entries *gymentry.Store,session gymstable.Session,saturday string) (Status,error)
func (s *Store) History(ctx context.Context,seeds *gymseed.Store,events *gymevent.Store,entries *gymentry.Store,session gymstable.Session,afterCardID string,limit uint32) (HistoryPage,error)
```

For Pin expose `ValidatePin(Pin)`, `MarshalPin(Pin)`, `ParsePin([]byte)` with the standard owned/error returns. For every other named gymcard DTO X expose `ValidateX(expected Pin,value X)(X,error)`, `MarshalX(expected Pin,value X)([]byte,error)`, `ParseX(expected Pin,raw []byte)(X,error)`. Child validators enforce only local/available-Pin constraints. ValidateEntrant checks closed fields/bounds but cannot derive its display name, rating or eligibility without an Assignment. ValidatePlan checks ordered unique members, local pairing/reason/count arithmetic, known gym IDs, BoutID from the supplied InputID/corners and Bout.seed from supplied Plan.seed; Pin+Plan alone cannot derive CardID, InputID or Plan.seed from absent event/snapshot/target facts. ValidateRecord derives the full expected Plan from its actual source and compares every field, all source/name/rating/eligibility/record facts, CardID/SourceDigest and available time bounds. Result validators additionally compare Status to their exact Record; standalone Status only checks locally available Pin/Event/state/count/time constraints, not an absent record digest/preimage. No redundant source fields are added merely to overclaim standalone validation. A pure `DerivePlan(expected Pin, source gymseed.CardSource)(Plan,error)` is allowed for independent conformance; it does not grant source authority or persist anything.

Caps: events256; page1..8; entrants10; gyms2; bouts5. Pin20KiB; Info24KiB; marker24KiB; metadata24KiB; CardSource160KiB; CardState12KiB; CardView120KiB; Plan16KiB; Record192KiB; Status16KiB; HistoryPage136KiB; BuildResult/ReadResult224KiB; eventual transport frame256KiB including LF. Existing full source snapshot receipt cap126976 remains unchanged. Core parses preflight depth<=16, field-name length<=64, duplicate/unknown/missing fields, literal nonnegative integers only (no floats/exponents/negative-zero), with the exact inherited -1 exceptions below, canonical lowercase IDs and every explicit array cap before allocation. Bound exact object shapes rather than a generic accepting decoder. Accept field-order/JSON whitespace transport, re-encode canonical JSON; no null arrays or nullable new fields. Old nested types keep only their specified old null exceptions. The only negative literals anywhere in new DTOs are `-1` in the inherited seed Status `scan_height` and `scan_tip_height`: CardState `status.{scan_height,scan_tip_height}`; CardView `states[*].status.{...}`; gymcard Status `source.status.{...}`; BuildResult/ReadResult `status.source.status.{...}`; HistoryPage `cards[*].source.status.{...}`. Each is otherwise0..MaxInt32. Complete source anchor/target heights, target_descendants and all other integers remain nonnegative; no suffix-wide negative allowance, -0, booleans, floats or exponents. These are datatype/context-aware paths, not free-form key-name permissions. Final independent formula check must establish these caps before freeze.

## 6. Durable transitions and authorization

All methods use concrete source handles borrowed only for the call; no caller-supplied trusted status/card/receipt, general callback importer or node adapter. `Info` is bounded parent-only install metadata with no account claim and no clock write. Constructors reject cheap PoW before path mutation and verify concrete source Pin/StoreID/immutable CreatedAtMS; store that source creation time for future comparisons.

Build takes artifact gate, validates input, authorizes original held-compatible View through WithCardView. Existing same-event row takes early immutable replay: validate it outside final lease, then return those exact bytes under final same-view source state; do not derive a new Plan or require newly healthy chain data. Conflicted replay remains visible with usable=false. Before new Build, WithCardSource supplies complete immutable source/no conflict. Derive/canonical-validate the record outside the account lease; final callback checks source/store creation identity, expected source digest, original View, local state/capacity and monotonic time, then synchronously inserts exactly one record plus metadata. Source/condition/name/Plan derivation and all full-object semantic validators must have completed before this final account lease. The final clock can advance: only explicit timestamp-bound checks, trusted canonical marshaling/hash of the already validated owned shape with its final time, and synchronous batch write are allowed there; do not call ValidateRecord, DerivePlan, GenerateText, Project or source public methods in that callback. Actual creation time is >=source observation, source receipt completion and first historical finality time. No new journal-created-before-cutoff restriction exists: card construction after seed finality is deliberately late.

Current conflict/overflow forbids a new card. Existing historical card bytes survive later conflict with fresh separate overlay. If a concrete source with the same claimed Pin loses/replaces immutable source digest or creation identity, return card_source_changed without overwriting cards or pretending they are current; do not silently rematch. A fresh authorized view may query/replay retained cards but never reconstructs missing rows merely by lookup. No automatic Build on navigation/login/restart/seed observation.

Read/Status/History advance authenticated source/local monotonic observation only, and may durably record existing seed deadline facts; they perform no chain RPC, proof, signing, rendering or fight. Source state read failures disclose no stale prior-view payload. Local clock rollback or actual now below the trusted source lower bound returns card_clock. Post-sync errors/cancellation return outcome_unknown and preserve exact deterministic ID for query/reopen. Metadata-only uncertainty must be labelled as such, never “transaction sent”. Existing successful card replay does not reset CreatedAtMS.

History sorts retained cards by cutoff then CardID, exclusive known cursor; limit1..8, unknown cursor card_not_found. NextCardID is last returned only when has_more=true; otherwise empty. It must retain prior Saturday records across date rollover. History uses a private bounded sorted index of only `(CardID, cutoff_ms)`, established by the successful full Open audit (empty at Create) and updated only after a successful synced insert. No separate persistent index is authoritative. Select from at most256 index entries, then load and fully validate only the selected<=8 DB Records and cross-check each ID/date against the index; check cancellation between rows. Unknown cursor is checked against the audited index. Missing/corrupt selected DB rows fail; never serve a cached full Record as proof. WithCardView then supplies at most8 final source states. Full audit still validates every raw row at Open, and no old validation requirement is dropped. The store gate prevents concurrent insert/index disagreement; precompute the next sorted index outside the final account lease, install it only after synced insertion, and discard it on a failed/uncertain sync until reopen rebuilds it. Info/poll caches never call History implicitly.

## 7. Journal and lock order

New separate `SLUG-CANDIDATE-CARDS.json` marker with canonical `application="SLUG candidate cards",version=1,store_id,pin`; child `db` only. LevelDB exact keys: ASCII `meta`; optional ASCII `init` only during recognized initialization; and byte `r` + raw CardID32. No extra keys, unknown prefixes, row overwrite, deletion or compaction-based pruning of history. Metadata canonical `version,store_id,pin,source_created_at_ms,created_at_ms,clock_ms,event_count`. Init intent canonical `version,store_id,pin,source_created_at_ms`.

Create accepts absent or real empty owned directory only, syncs exact Pin marker/init intent before sampling actual creation time, then syncs metadata and deletes init in one batch. ResumePrepared alone may complete exact marker-only/recognized init-only states with fresh actual time, or reopen exact already initialized empty state preserving times; it never adopts an arbitrary nonempty DB. Open/ready refuses missing/partial storage. Parent prepared recovery must require event_count0; normal Open allows valid retained rows. Constructors inspect protected paths/symlinks and bounded raw values before decode, and full audit recomputes every Plan/Record identity/count/time relation and event_count. It validates structural source semantics without Argon/RPC or signatures being produced. Use old seed protected-directory/init pattern, not a new generic persistence framework.

Resource gates: card→seed→event→entry→original account; final mutexes entry→event→seed→card. Compute before final lease; callback does only checks, bounded copies/clock sampling and sync. It cannot reenter any source/account/card public method. No account/source mutation follows a foreign callback in the same invocation. Track a possible/confirmed consumer sync separately from source observation writes: any outer error after that point is outcome_unknown even if the source wrapper otherwise maps it to cancellation. Local sync uncertainty poisons until reopen. No rollback of a successful durable card to hide a failed disclosure.

Close cancels lifetime and joins the current operation/gate before closing DB; no orphan worker. Do not introduce a mutex wait before the context-selectable gate. Distinguish completed dependency closure from caller cancellation using the corrected gymstable pattern. Parent closes child lane first, then shared card→seed→event; entry/stable handles are borrowed under existing lane and never retained across Start/Stop replacement.

Errors (exact strings): common invalid_request, unauthorized, forbidden, stale_view, busy, outcome_unknown; card_unavailable, card_corrupt, card_capacity, card_clock, card_calendar, card_not_found, card_source_incomplete, card_source_conflict, card_source_changed, card_cancelled; internal ErrClosed="card store closed", ErrPoisoned="card write uncertain; reopen required", ErrProfile="card requires production PoW". Missing event/seed/finality for a new Build is source_incomplete; malformed callers are invalid; concrete mismatched Pin/participant is forbidden. Pure new DTO/plan validation of duplicated full ProspectID, wrong array order, changed derived name/condition/count/reason or incompatible source/profile returns the package ErrInvalid. Encountering those impossible facts in a retained concrete source/card row maps to ErrCorrupt (no card insertion), not to unmatched or silent row deduplication. No publisher-specific error or fee authority is introduced.

## 8. Scoped normal-PoW test clock constructors

Only files built with `//go:build slugtestclock` expose these wrappers, using private constructor dependencies and no mutable global clock. Nil clock refuses. Exact signatures append `clock func() time.Time` to ordinary core constructor arguments:

```go
func CreateForTestClock(ctx context.Context,path string,pin Pin,seeds *gymseed.Store,clock func() time.Time) (*Store,error)
func OpenForTestClock(ctx context.Context,path string,pin Pin,seeds *gymseed.Store,clock func() time.Time) (*Store,error)
func ResumePreparedForTestClock(ctx context.Context,path string,pin Pin,seeds *gymseed.Store,clock func() time.Time) (*Store,error)
```

Normal constructors use private `time.Now`, normal builds have no public clock argument/config/flag/environment hook. Reopen retains the same scoped clock only through the owned tagged fixture constructor. All source pins remain the two compiled published fixtures; `slugtestpow` is rejected before filesystem effects even if combined with `slugtestclock`. No existing core clock wrapper or schema changes. Helper wrappers are specified separately by their owner.

## 9. Remaining review work, not new policy

Before freeze: independent exact shape/cap audit; source-callback/codec review with helper owner; crash stages and corpus coverage. Existing normal releases must contain no test clock or cheap-PoW flags. No implementation until root freezes both core/helper contracts.

Acceptance must cover all five classes, exact half/double/equal and just-outside ratios; the complete reason priority/partition including empty and ineligible rows; source reordering/corner order; source/recipe/digest changes; same-event replay and immutable timestamp; held participant authorization versus stale/revoked/foreign/mining token; conflicts before/after computation/commit and late overlay; historical finality offline/shallow above target; callback source closure and cancellation; sync failure/SIGKILL/reopen; source swap/missing-ready/no adoption; bounded parser/card/history/cache and unchanged old APIs. A populated256-record capacity test must verify first/late/exhausted pages, exact<=8 full-record validations per page and selected-row corruption/cancellation; helper integration must exercise a late page within its unchanged250ms metadata deadline, with honest busy handling under actual contention. Frozen independent synthetic matcher/source cases are not labelled admitted proofs. Genuine Set44/45 published source records separately exercise concrete authority; no new public mining, private keys, record ledger, official pairing or D74 claim.
